Name: Sriram Nadathur
Bio:
Sriram Nadathur is a Founder of Plaksha. He is an entrepreneur, angel investor, and co-head of Nadathur Group. He leads the group's private investments in biotech, healthcare, materials science, nature-inspired innovation, and related deep-tech sectors. Sriram has also served on the board of the group's hospitality business, as well as the group's technology arm, investing in a wide range of startups.

Prior to joining Nadathur Group, Sriram worked in startups and also co-founded Syndicated Research Group, a subscription-based research business serving CXOs of F500 companies.
Education: BTech, Industrial Engineering, R.V. College | MBA, Northeastern University, Boston | MS, Biomimicry, Arizona State University (ASU)
